prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one polished hand-painted Age of Sail adventure game event illustration. Landscape 4:3 composition, single continuous full-bleed scene, no panels, no border, no title, no lettering, no readable text, no logo or watermark. Rich realistic materials and painterly detail, clear bold focal subject readable at 256-pixel thumbnail, naturally proportioned people. Golden Tide merchant-route art direction: luminous turquoise and deep blue sea, warm golden sunlight, weathered wood, brass, cream canvas and rich red merchant sails. No modern objects, no anachronisms, no extraneous plot elements. Avoid clutter; compose specifically for the described event, with important subjects away from edges. 
Scene: On the bow deck of a supply boat a practical anonymous ship-ration tasting is underway. Several plain unlabeled bowls and wooden plates of preserved sea provisions stand in a neat row on a wooden tasting table. A cook and two visiting sailors thoughtfully taste and compare them; another supply boat is tied nearby. Focus on appealing food samples and friendly expressive people, bright golden daylight, red sail shade and blue sea; no readable labels.
